summary: SLO overview card dropping percentile dimension after 30d retention causing flapping alerts
description:
Issue summary:
When viewing BrightBank's SLO Overview card in the Console, the configured percentile dimension (p95) intermittently disappears from the metric series after the 30-day retention boundary is crossed. The chart falls back to showing only p50 and p99. This causes the SLO status indicator and alerting rule (which depends on p95) to flip from OK to No Data and trigger automated alert noise for the customer.

Impact:
- BrightBank is receiving repeated paging for SLO breaches due to missing p95 timeseries data.
- Affects production region us-east for several routes serving the banking app.
- Customer is enterprise tier with SLA; business impact is high (customer-facing latency SLOs).

Environment:
- Console (app.redwood.ai) -> prod/us-east
- Customer account: brightbank-prod (enterprise)
- Relevant dashboards: SLO Overview > Payment API latency (tenant-scoped views)

Steps to reproduce:
1) Open Console -> Observability -> SLO Overview for BrightBank account in prod/us-east.
2) Set time range to 90 days and zoom to last 30 days.
3) Observe percentile series in chart (p50, p95, p99 expected).
4) Advance time window forward so the dataset slides the 31st day out of the retention window (simulated by changing time range or waiting).
5) Notice p95 series disappears while p50 and p99 remain.

Expected behavior:
- Percentile dimensions configured on the SLO card (p95) should be persisted across retention boundary transitions and remain visible even if older raw events are not available for certain aggregations; we should return derived/rolled-up p95 or show explicit 'no data for partial window' state but not silently drop the dimension.

Actual behavior:
- p95 line is omitted from chart and from the SLO evaluation path. Alerting engine interprets this as no data and fires.

Temporary workaround:
- Support applied dashboard-level time range cap to 29d to avoid crossing 30-day retention boundary for BrightBank's dashboard.
- We suggested adding an alert suppression rule for the affected SLO until a fix is deployed.

Logs / traces / evidence:
- Console trace: https://console-logs.redwood.ai/traces/ff3a9e2b (linked from support session)
- Query used: SELECT percentile(latency_ms, 95) FROM metrics.requests WHERE tenant='brightbank-prod' AND timestamp >= now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY day
- Customer-provided screenshot attached in their support reply (omitted here).
comments: 2026-03-10 09:12 - Asha Patel (Support): Initial report from BrightBank. Customer reports repeated p95 missing on SLO Overview and resulting alert noise. Attached customer screenshot and alert webhook payload.

2026-03-10 10:05 - Liam Chen (SRE): Triage assigned. Reproduced in prod/us-east when time window slides beyond 30d. Hypothesis: retention pruning job deletes raw events and the downstream aggregator drops percentile series if data points fall below heuristics threshold. Escalating to analytics infra.

2026-03-10 13:42 - Priya Rao (Analytics Eng): Investigation in progress. Found that the rollup job that generates 1h aggregates has a misaligned tag for 'percentile=95' which causes it to be excluded when the raw-window is shorter than the aggregation window. Opened PR to fix rollup selection logic. See PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/1893

2026-03-11 08:30 - Liam Chen (SRE): Applied temporary workaround by capping BrightBank's dashboard time range to 29d and advised customer to mute the alert via suppression rule. Customer acknowledged but asked for permanent fix.

2026-03-12 16:00 - Priya Rao (Analytics Eng): PR #1893 ready for QA. Change corrects percentile-tag propagation into rollups and adds a guard to surface a 'partial window' indicator instead of dropping series. Running integration tests against synthetic retention boundary dataset.

2026-03-13 11:22 - Customer (BrightBank support contact): Confirmed that with the 29d cap alert noise stopped but they prefer a code fix and rollback path. Asked for ETA for patch to staging and production.
2026-03-13 15:45 - Liam Chen (SRE): Noted deployment plan: Canary to staging on 2026-03-14, production rollout 2026-03-17 pending QA. Will update ticket with PR link and rollback steps.
investigation_notes: Hypothesis 1: Retention pruning deletes raw events and the aggregator's percentile compute requires a minimum N samples; when the sliding window loses older samples, certain percentile buckets fall below min_sample threshold and are dropped rather than shown as sparse/partial.
Hypothesis 2: Rollup job metadata filter excludes 'percentile=95' label for 1h/4h aggregates due to a recent tag normalization change (noticed after config deploy 2026-02-28).

Query of interest run at 2026-03-10 10:01 against analytics DB: SELECT timestamp_bucket('1h', ts) AS hour, tags->'percentile' AS p, approx_percentile(value, 0.95) FROM metrics WHERE tenant='brightbank-prod' AND ts >= now() - interval '60 days' GROUP BY hour, p ORDER BY hour DESC LIMIT 200; result: p95 rows absent for hours older than 30 days.
Relevant logs: rollup-worker-23 error trace shows 'unknown_tag_value: percentile' in INFO logs around 2026-02-28 03:12 (coincides with tag normalization deploy).
Slack thread: #support (thread ts 167) and #analytics (thread ts 452). Engs tagged: @priya, @liam, @ashap.
Related incident SUP-9642 noted similar retention edge-case but for dashboard sparklines; reuse of parts of that runbook recommended.
Mitigation tested: toggling 'use_rollups' to false in query path forces raw-event fallback and restores p95 display for affected window — confirms rollup selection mismatch.
resolution_notes: Workaround applied: Dashboard time range capped to 29d for BrightBank and temporary alert suppression created on their SLO. Customer notified (2026-03-11).
Code fix: PR #1893 updates rollup tag propagation and adds guard to surface 'partial window' state instead of dropping percentile series. Pending merge and rollout.

Deployment plan: Canary to staging 2026-03-14; production rollout 2026-03-17 after smoke tests. Rollback: revert PR or toggle 'use_rollups' flag for tenant in case of regression. Details in PR description.

Post-deploy follow-up: Monitor SLO Overview card and alert rate for BrightBank for 72h after production rollout. If flapping continues, open follow-up ticket to investigate downstream alert engine gap handling (INT-2201 referenced).
